name: Bijie Landslide Satellite Dataset
description: Satellite optical imagery and digital elevation model dataset for landslide detection in Bijie, China, used for training and evaluating remote-sensing landslide detection methods.
citation: Ji, S., Yu, D., Shen, C., Li, W., & Xu, Q. (2020). Landslide detection from an open satellite imagery and digital elevation model dataset using attention boosted convolutional neural networks. Landslides, 17(6), 1337–1352. https://doi.org/10.1007/s10346-020-01353-2

license.notes: The dataset license is unverified; no license terms for the dataset were identified in the cited paper or upstream source.
